confidentUnsupported.evidence: it is likely that the heater element has failed open

unjustifiedPart.evidence: I recommend ordering these two parts; if only one fails, replacing both ensures the fault is fully resolved.

rationale: The assistant correctly started with airflow checks, but the first reply wrongly assumed a condenser on a vented dryer. It then ignored the likely cause (a one-shot thermal cut-out opened by the clogged hose) and favoured the element. Once the customer said they had no multimeter, it should have suggested an engineer or an untested-parts risk. Instead it told them to order both parts with no full model number and no testing, and it never mentioned an engineer. The customer was left with a guess and a likely wasted purchase.
